taxonomy.note: Accepted by Kew POWO and ITIS; native to Texas and western/central North America.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Kerr — Kerr Wildlife Management Area vascular flora vouchers Cirsium ochrocentrum. Additional verified Texas records were located outside the project target zone (e.g. Presidio, Jeff Davis, Pecos, Lubbock).
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need two more exact target-zone counties.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not treat broad Edwards Plateau or Texas-wide presence as county occurrence.

morphology.look_here_first: Look for a perennial gray-woolly thistle with yellowish spine tips, often multiple stems from one root crown, and purple/pink heads above strongly tomentose foliage.
diagnostic_traits: one to many woolly gray-white stems
dry grassland and rocky western-plains habitat
